scope: Fresh owned MariaDB proof for the two audit-only ArenaService projection reads; not a replacement for original capacity or native Arena acceptance.

ownership.database: A new audit-owned database and independently allocated non-user port only
ownership.configuration: Only the new owner's generated private configuration, checked by ownership marker and exact path
ownership.cleanup: Rollback all proof transactions; delete only owned fixture accounts through the guarded owner; graceful Apache and MariaDB closure with residual and protected-port checks

fixture.largeEvidenceRows: Use deterministic valid JSON for each of events_json, evidence_json and metrics_json to make projection transfer visible; exact private values and SQL results must not be exported

checks.name: Same native query-plan shape
checks.method: EXPLAIN full members, active scalar members and response scalar members with the same guarded arena_id, predicate and slot ordering. Compare access_type, chosen key, row estimate and ordering/filesort indicators; retain bounded facts. A different chosen plan is not silently accepted.

checks.name: Full lock blocks both projection reads
checks.method: Connection A begins transaction and executes the original full-row locking read. Independent connection B uses a bounded session-local lock wait and must receive native lock-timeout1205 for either projection in that same room. No global lock policy changes.

checks.name: Both projections retain every member write lock
checks.method: For each projection, connection A locks the eight members; independent connection B attempts an UPDATE against each of the eight unique primary keys and must receive lock-timeout1205. Each failed B transaction is rolled back. All eight seats must be checked; a successful same-room write fails the proof.

checks.name: Other occupied room remains independent
checks.method: While A retains each projection's first-room locks, B can update its separately owned second-room member and roll back. Preserve original room-isolation scope and report actual errors.

checks.name: Fresh snapshots observe committed same-owner changes
checks.method: Execute each read at the same service call sites in one owned transaction, apply the existing heartbeat/member-state change, and re-read. Compare full-reference scalar projection to the candidate without caching either result.

checks.name: Bounded paired transfer diagnostic
checks.method: If separately approved, use twelve alternating pairs with fresh statements, same fixed rows, no warmup/filter/retry, and retain every measurement. Separate execute/fetch timings and actual transferred/returned byte counts; do not infer strict HTTP acceptance from this diagnostic.

acceptanceStillRequired.full: Original1653 operations,50rooms x8seats,20concurrent HTTP requests,strict successful-request p95 below150ms,all phases and original assertions retained
acceptanceStillRequired.wire: Same independent original1653-operation protocol with production wire; preserve measured order/cache state
acceptanceStillRequired.nativeArena: All original32 HTTP lifecycle/finish/history/immutable retry checks with full final chart
acceptanceStillRequired.pureContracts: Original Arena/query/clock/prefix/receipt/security contracts plus audit candidate projection parity
